title: Tata Motors October 2026 model-wise dispatches (Rushlane 14 Nov, GaadiWaadi 15 Nov): new Sierra 7,205, more than Harrier 3,895 (-13% from 4,483) and Safari 2,287 (-9% from 2,510) combined (6,182); total 73,894, +12,760 (+21%) from 61,134; Sierra + Aeris (4,005) = 11,210 of the 12,760 gain (Rushlane: nearly 88%); Nexon 21,966 (-1% from 22,083) leads Punch 20,525 (+22% from 16,810; +3,715, the biggest gain among models on sale in Oct 2025) by 1,441, up from 123 in September (Nexon 20,456, Punch 20,333); Tiago 8,043 (-9%), Altroz 3,257 (-14%) down; Curvv 2,377 (+66% from 1,432); Tigor 334 (-72%). Dispatches to dealers, not registrations.
headline: 7,205 Sierras Shipped in October: More Than Harrier, Safari Combined
